article.title: SoftBank Weighs Deal for Robotics Startup Gravis
article.summary: SoftBank Group Corp. is considering an acquisition of Gravis Robotics AG, people familiar with the matter said, as the Japanese investor targets the artificial intelligence technologies underpinning robotics.
article.title_zh: SoftBank 考慮收購機器人新創公司 Gravis
article.summary_zh: 知情人士表示 SoftBank 正考慮收購 Gravis Robotics AG，該日本投資者鎖定支撐機器人的人工智慧技術。

article.title: Paramount/WBD merger delayed for months as states' lawsuit moves toward trial
article.summary: Paramount Skydance agreed to a longer-term delay of its $111 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, preventing the companies from combining until after a judge rules on the merits of a case in which a dozen states challenged the legality of the merger. Under a stipulation filed in court today, the states and companies agreed that the merger will not be completed and the firms will not integrate their operations until "five days after the merits determination in these matters," or on June 1, 2027, whichever is earlier. The delay was also agreed to by the Writers Guild of America, which filed its own lawsuit to block the merger. article.title_zh: Paramount/WBD合併因州政府訴訟推遲數月
article.summary_zh: Paramount Skydance同意延長1110億美元收購Warner Bros. Discovery的期限，防止兩公司在法官就十多個州質疑合併合法性的訴訟案做出裁決前合併。

article.title: China-US AI Race Escalates, OpenAI Models Break Free, and Why You Should Check Your Car Alarm
article.summary: On this episode of Uncanny Valley, we dive into accusations that China’s Moonshot AI stole from Anthropic, and how the US Army needs to cut back on AI use.
article.title_zh: 中美AI競賽升溫、OpenAI模型突破、以及為何應檢查汽車警報器
article.summary_zh: 本期Uncanny Valley節目探討中國Moonshot AI涉嫌竊取Anthropic技術的指控，以及美國陸軍需減少AI使用的問題。

article.title: Claude’s voice mode is getting a lot more useful with support for more models and tools
article.summary: TL;DR Claude’s voice mode can now use multiple models, including Opus and Sonnet. It can also use connected tools like Notion, Canva, and others to complete tasks in voice mode. The new update is rolling out in public beta on mobile, desktop, and the web. If you prefer talking to your AI chatbots, Anthropic has some great news for you. The company launched voice mode in Claude last year and started rolling out multilingual support last month. Now, Anthropic is giving the feature a major update that could make it better than the competition. Anthropic announced a couple of new features for Claude’s voice mode in an X post today. article.title_zh: Claude 語音模式支援更多模型和工具，變得更加實用
article.summary_zh: Claude 語音模式現支援 Opus 和 Sonnet 等多個模型，並可連接 Notion、Canva 等工具。

article.title: OpenAI relaunches Apple Health-connected ChatGPT feature with expanded access
article.summary: OpenAI is relaunching Health in ChatGPT, the AI-powered feature that connects to Apple Health on iPhone. The relaunch comes with expanded access and a big step forward in results.
article.title_zh: OpenAI 重新推出連結 Apple Health 的 ChatGPT 功能，擴大使用範圍
article.summary_zh: OpenAI 重新推出 ChatGPT 的 Health 功能，可連結 iPhone 上的 Apple Health，並提供擴大的使用範圍和改進的結果。

article.title: EU fines Google $1 billion for ‘preferential treatment’ in Search, Play Store
article.summary: Google is looking at two fines from the European Union, which claims the company violated the Digital Markets Act with both Search and the Google Play Store.
article.title_zh: 歐盟因 Search 和 Play Store 中的「優惠待遇」對 Google 罰款 10 億美元
article.summary_zh: 歐盟以 Google 違反《數位市場法》為由，對其 Search 和 Google Play Store 進行罰款。

article.title: Nothing will reportedly stop selling in many global markets as latest phones struggle
article.summary: Nothing is apparently set to stop selling phones in a swath of global markets due to declining sales, while its new Nothing Phone (4a) and Phone (4b) releases are struggling to find success.
article.title_zh: 據報 Nothing 將停止在多個全球市場銷售，因最新手機銷售困難
article.summary_zh: Nothing 據傳將因銷售下滑停止在多個全球市場銷售 Nothing Phone (4a) 和 Phone (4b)。

article.title: Your Fitbit Air is getting a new update, but don’t expect flashy new features
article.summary: TL;DR Google has started rolling out Fitbit Air firmware version 253.2. The update only includes minor bug fixes, with no new features or user-facing changes mentioned in Google’s announcement. Google recommends installing the update during the day and keeping the Google Health app open throughout the process. Google has started rolling out a new software update for the Fitbit Air . However, this release is more about improving reliability than introducing new features. According to Google’s community announcement , firmware version 253.2 is now making its way to Fitbit Air devices over the next few days. The company says the update contains minor bug fixes, without going into specifics of what those fixes include.
article.title_zh: 你的 Fitbit Air 即將迎來新更新，但別期待華麗的新功能
article.summary_zh: Google 開始推出 Fitbit Air 韌體版本 253.2 更新，僅包含輕微錯誤修復，Google 公告中未提及新功能或面向用戶的變更。

article.title: The EU Fines Google $1 Billion for Prioritizing Its Own Services in Search
article.summary: The European Commission claims that Google boosted its own apps and products to the top of search rankings to the detriment of its competitors.
article.title_zh: 歐盟因 Google 在搜索中優先考慮自有服務而罰款 10 億美元
article.summary_zh: 歐洲委員會聲稱 Google 將自有應用程序和產品提升至搜索排名的頂部，損害了競爭對手的利益。

article.title: Anthropic upgrades Claude with new Opus 5 model, details here
article.summary: Anthropic has released its latest AI model with Claude Opus 5. The new version arrives about two months after the previous Opus model upgrade, matching Anthropic’s previous upgrade cadence.
article.title_zh: Anthropic 升級 Claude 推出新 Opus 5 模型
article.summary_zh: Anthropic 發佈了最新的 AI 模型 Claude Opus 5，距前一個 Opus 版本升級僅隔兩個月，符合 Anthropic 的升級週期。

article.title: Samsung Inks $200 Billion Chip Supply with Broadcom
article.summary: Samsung Electronics Co. won a contract worth more than $200 billion to make chips for Broadcom Inc., as the companies race to win a larger share of the AI infrastructure market.
article.title_zh: 三星與 Broadcom 簽署 2,000 億美元晶片供應協議
article.summary_zh: 三星電子與 Broadcom Inc. 簽訂價值超過 2,000 億美元的合約，製造 Broadcom 的晶片，雙方競相爭奪 AI 基礎設施市場更大的份額。
